snippet.title: Jetpack Joyride Racing Official Trailer | Launching April 10, 2026
snippet.description:
Get ready to race like never before! ⚡️

Dive into Jetpack Joyride Racing, the ultimate multiplayer racing experience set in the iconic Jetpack Joyride universe. Drift through tight corners, boost past rivals, and battle for the win in fast-paced races where every wall can be your advantage and every turn tests your skill.

Race for free with no strings attached, or take it to the next level with Halfbrick+ to unlock new racers, tracks, and epic customizations.

Pre-register Jetpack Joyride Racing on iOS & Android now 🚀 https://halfbrick.link/PreRegJJR
